name: Shinanomachi
tagline: Shinjuku in 6 minutes and Shibuya in 16 minutes. Served by 1 line. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥110,000 to ¥120,000.
summary: The station is in Shinjuku City, where JR East run 1 line between them. Journey times to the main business districts are 20 minutes to Otemachi, 6 minutes to Shinjuku, 16 minutes to Shibuya and 32 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥110,000 to ¥120,000. The station stands 27.2 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 15.9 m. The land around the station has gentle slopes.

terrain.note: The station sits on the higher side of the ground around it, at 27.2 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 18.1 m to 34 m, a difference of 15.9 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls outside the projected inundation area. Even so, 2 of the nine points within 400 m fall inside the area, and the deepest projection there is less than 0.5 m. On the whole, the flood projection here is among the smallest in the 23 wards.
medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 4 clinics and 6 pharmacies. Day-to-day care is available close to the station. The nearest hospital is 慶應義塾大学病院, about 6 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is 仁圭会林外科病院, about 9 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 1 line serve the station: JR Chuo-Sobu Line (Local).
congestion: JR Chuo-Sobu Line (Local) runs at 151% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch is 錦糸町→両国, which this station is not on. At 150%, the ministry's scale describes shoulders not quite touching, with crowding near the doors. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

rentRange.note: Around this station, One room ¥110,000 to ¥120,000 and 1K ¥140,000 to ¥150,000. 1LDK ¥210,000 to ¥220,000 and 2LDK ¥330,000 to ¥340,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.

rentReason: A one-room flat here goes for ¥110,000 to ¥120,000. Set against how long it takes to reach the central business districts, that is on the low side. a small projected flood depth pushes the figure up. On the other side, only one line, the {line}, serving the station and little daily shopping within walking distance holds it down. For 1LDK, 2LDK, though, the sources differ by ¥30,000 or more. They count different sets of properties, so read those figures as a range rather than a point.

neighbours.lead: rents are lower at Shinanomachi, but Kokuritsu-Kyogijo is ahead on quiet.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Shinanomachi. It reaches Otemachi in about the same time as Shinanomachi. One-room rents run about ¥22,000 higher.

neighbours.lead: rents are lower at Shinanomachi, but Sendagaya is ahead on how easy the shopping is.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Shinanomachi. It reaches Otemachi in about the same time as Shinanomachi. One-room rents run about ¥22,000 higher.

goodFor: People commuting to Otemachi and Marunouchi
notFor: People who want another route when service is suspended
People who want to finish their shopping on foot
People who want plenty of places to eat out
noiseSources: The 首都高速4号新宿線 viaduct runs right beside the station. It is an expressway, so traffic is audible day and night
外苑東通り (3 lanes each way) runs right beside the station. Traffic on it never stops, so for a flat close to the station, check whether it faces the road

leads.terrain: There are gentle slopes around the station, and which block you live on changes how much effort getting about takes.
leads.groceries: OpenStreetMap records no supermarket within walking distance of the station.
leads.hazards: The station itself is outside the projected flood area, but blocks nearby are inside it.
leads.stationNote: Only the JR Chuo-Sobu Line (Local) serves this station, so when it stops you walk to another station.
leads.rentRange: Set against how long the commute takes, rents here are on the low side.
leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is about average for the 23 wards.
leads.congestion: Morning loading on the lines here is about average for the 23 wards' stations.
leads.noiseSources: At this station, check the traffic noise before the noise people make.
